partners.mechanism_chain: F12 (HGNC:3759) —DISRUPTS→ contact system activation (REACT:R-VIVO-70016); contact system activation (REACT:R-VIVO-70016) —LEADS_TO→ bleeding tendency (HP:0001928); KNG1 (HGNC:6410) —DISRUPTS→ coagulation cascade (REACT:R-VIVO-70014); coagulation cascade (REACT:R-VIVO-70014) —LEADS_TO→ contact system activation (REACT:R-VIVO-70016); contact system activation (REACT:R-VIVO-70016) —LEADS_TO→ thrombosis (HP:0001303). Loss-of-function mutations in F12 lead to impaired contact system activation, which can paradoxically manifest as bleeding tendencies due to a less robust initiation of the coagulation cascade. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in KNG1 impair the contact system and kinin-kallikrein pathways, also impacting coagulation and potentially leading to bleeding. However, the role of F12 in regulating thrombin generation and its interaction with other coagulation factors means that F12 deficiency can also be associated with thrombotic events, representing a complex overlap in pathway disruption.

partners.mechanism_chain: F12 (HGNC:3750) —DISRUPTS→ Coagulation Cascade (REACT:R-V1-1960930); Coagulation Cascade (REACT:R-V1-1960930) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital Factor XII Deficiency (MONDO:0009315); C1QBP (HGNC:2154) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial Respiratory Chain Complex I (GO:0005751); Mitochondrial Respiratory Chain Complex I (GO:0005751) —LEADS_TO→ Combined Oxidative Phosphorylation Deficiency 33 (MONDO:0054677).
